jobDescription:
Software Engineer — Computational Chemistry Platform

We build the simulation and data infrastructure that computational chemists use
to design molecules. Our users are PhD chemists; our codebase is Python and C++.

Responsibilities
- Build and maintain pipelines processing molecular dynamics trajectories
- Implement numerical methods for property prediction, working from papers
- Partner with bench chemists to turn experimental workflows into software
- Keep scientific correctness verifiable: regression suites over known systems

Requirements
- Strong software engineering fundamentals; Python required, C++ a plus
- Coursework or working knowledge in chemistry — organic, physical, or
  quantum. You should be able to read a chemistry paper and implement it
- Comfort with numerical computing: NumPy, linear algebra, floating-point care
- BS in CS, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a joint degree

This is a software engineering role. We are not looking for a chemist who
codes; we are looking for an engineer who is not afraid of the chemistry.
